page_title: VIL 0-2 RMA | Villarreal v Real Madrid 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Cesar Soto Grado is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' 0 - 2 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Luiz Junior.
90+3' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+3' Real Madrid are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
90+1' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90+1' Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' The attendance for today's match is 20432.
87' Villarreal force a corner. They send men into the box.
83' The linesman makes the right call and Villarreal will have a corner.
80' Substitution. Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) in, Arda Guler out.
77' Substitution. Georges Mikautadze did his best and is replaced by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal).
77' Marcelino has decided to substitute Dani Parejo and he is replaced by Thomas Partey (Villarreal).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Franco Mastantuono departs the field of play to be replaced by Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid).
74' Real Madrid have a corner.
71' It's a nice effort by Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Thibaut Courtois. Easy save.
70' Here is a change. Gerard Moreno is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal).
70' A substitution has been made. Tajon Buchanan is replaced by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal).
68' The referee awards a corner and Arda Guler (Real Madrid) goes over to take it.
65' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
64' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' What an opportunity! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which goes just over the crossbar!
62' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
58' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Cesar Soto Grado had a clear view and blows his whistle.
57' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
56' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the right post.
53' One of the Villarreal players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
51' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
47' 0 - 1 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
46' The whistle blows and Cesar Soto Grado starts the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
45+1' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) will take the corner.
43' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked.
41' Ooh that was close! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
39' The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
39' Real Madrid will take a corner kick.
32' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) tackles a bit over-zealously and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
31' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) prepares to take a corner kick.
25' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) receives a reproachful look from Jude Bellingham. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
24' Marcelino is forced to make a change. Juan Foyth is unable to continue due to injury, Rafa Marin (Villarreal) comes on.
23' It doesn’t look good for Juan Foyth (Villarreal); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
22' The game is interrupted now, Juan Foyth (Villarreal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the top right corner is thwarted by Luiz Junior.
19' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way past the right post.
12' The ball is out of play. Villarreal win a corner kick.
12' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
6' Corner kick. Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is ready to send the ball into the box.
2' What was Juan Foyth (Villarreal) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Cesar Soto Grado.
